# Vendored QR Code generator

This directory contains the C++ implementation from [Project Nayuki's QR Code generator](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator), specifically the files under `cpp/`.

Copyright (c) Project Nayuki. Distributed under the MIT License. The original copyright and permission notice are retained at the top of both vendored source files. Upstream project page: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library.

PKGMaster uses this library to encode the one-time phone pairing URL as a standards-compliant QR Code. No QR payload is uploaded or sent to a third party.
